title: Ralph and Vanellope in the land of games.
lines: In a big arcade there are lots and lots of game machines.
During the day the children play on them.
But at night, when the arcade is closed, the characters come to life.
Ralph lives in one game.
Ralph is big, with giant hands.
In his game he has to wreck a block of flats.
Boom, boom!
Then Felix comes with his golden hammer.
Tink, tink.
Felix fixes everything again.
Then Felix gets a medal.
And Ralph gets thrown off the roof.
Into the mud.
Ralph is sad.
Everyone thinks he's the bad guy.
Nobody invites him to a party.
I want a medal too, says Ralph.
Then they'll see that I can be a hero.
Ralph sneaks into another game.
There he can win a medal.
He grabs the medal!
But by accident he ends up in yet another game.
A game full of sweets.
It's called Sugar Rush.
The trees are made of candy canes.
The roads are made of chocolate.
The mountains are made of cake.
A little girl lives there.
Vanellope.
She has sweets in her hair.
She's cheeky and funny.
Vanellope takes Ralph's medal.
She wants to buy a race car with it.
She wants to enter the big race.
But the other children in the game laugh at her.
They say she's a glitch.
Because sometimes she flickers.
She jumps a little bit to the side.
Bzzzt.
Ralph sees that Vanellope is alone too.
Just like him.
He helps her build a car.
Out of biscuits and sweets and icing.
It's a funny car.
But Vanellope thinks it's wonderful.
Ralph teaches her to drive on a mountain of ice.
She falls a lot.
But she practises.
On the day of the race Vanellope joins in.
The other cars push her.
But then Vanellope uses her glitch.
Bzzzt!
She jumps right through the other cars.
Nasty bugs come into the game.
They want to eat everything.
Ralph does something very brave.
He smashes the top of the candy mountain.
A fizzy drink volcano erupts.
The light lures the bugs away.
Vanellope wins the race.
And then something amazing turns out.
Vanellope is really the princess of the game!
Ralph goes back to his own game.
He wrecks things again.
But now he doesn't mind.
Because now he knows.
A bad guy in a game can be a really good friend.
The end.
